objective: Webhook trigger binding into automation flow and dynamic map Rhai evaluation

eval_with_dynamic_map evaluates Rhai AST with dynamic Map input and returns ChainFireResult for Alert and ActionCommand
WebhookFieldMappingEditor allows toggling mode ('flow' vs 'direct') and configuring field mappings in NodeEditorPanel
